categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Jiachi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, research, manufacturing, testing, sales, and services of electromagnetic functional materials and structures (EMMS). Its main product lines include stealth functional coating materials, stealth functional structural components, stealth maintenance materials, and electromagnetic compatibility materials. The company also develops new generation anechoic chamber systems and key absorbing materials, providing integrated design and testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced core technologies such as thin radar absorbing coatings, low-emission infrared coatings, multi-spectrum compatible coatings, broadband functional materials, high-performance composite absorbers, ultra-wideband nonlinear gradient absorbing honeycomb materials, and low-detectability stealth structural design and manufacturing techniques. Production methods include multi-axis machining, 3D printing, automated preparation systems, and specialized coating and molding processes. The company emphasizes proprietary R&D and engineering applications to break foreign technology blockades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are military clients, including major domestic military-industrial groups and research institutes, focusing on stealth weaponry and electronic information systems. Civilian markets include consumer electronics, communication devices, automotive electronics, and smart devices requiring electromagnetic compatibility solutions. The company serves key sectors such as aviation, aerospace, electronics, weapons, and naval vessels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Its products and services cater to domestic military and civilian markets. There is no significant mention of overseas operations or international markets in the report.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Jiachi operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the R&D, manufacturing, and testing of advanced electromagnetic materials and components. It acts as a key supplier to military equipment manufacturers and electronic product assemblers, providing customized materials and integrated testing services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on low-frequency ultra-wideband stealth materials, multi-spectrum compatibility, thin and lightweight materials, and multifunctional coatings. It is advancing new generation anechoic chamber systems and stealth maintenance products. R&D efforts emphasize autonomous innovation, breaking foreign technology barriers, and expanding applications in both military and civilian sectors. The company plans to enhance integrated design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities while cultivating a strong talent pool.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of proprietary electromagnetic functional materials and structural components to military and civilian customers. The company also earns income from integrated system design, testing services, and technical support. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, with customized product development and batch production following product validation and military certification.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu Jiachi is a leading domestic provider in the EMMS field, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion'. It holds a dominant position in China’s stealth materials and electromagnetic compatibility markets, with significant technological advantages over competitors. The company has broken foreign monopolies in key technologies and maintains strong relationships with major military and civilian clients.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 956.8 million, a slight decrease of 2.45% from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 517.3 million, down 8.23%. Total assets reached RMB 3.65 billion, nearly doubling from the prior year, mainly due to a successful IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market in December 2024, raising net proceeds of approximately RMB 1 billion. The company shows steady growth with strong cash flow generation and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary core technologies in EMMS, offering products with superior low-frequency ultra-wideband absorption, multi-spectrum stealth compatibility, and thin, lightweight characteristics. Its integrated solutions for stealth coatings, structural components, and maintenance materials provide enhanced survivability and operational efficiency for military platforms. Additionally, its new generation anechoic chambers and key absorbing materials offer significant advantages in performance, lifespan, and cost, differentiating it from competitors and meeting critical national defense and high-tech civilian needs.
